0.content: Dahlia's first meeting with Venti came in a tavern: seeing a bard alone among empty bottles, he assumed a frustrated artist and kept him company. After the bard's twenty-eighth cider, it turned out he was simply celebrating a sweet harvest. Dahlia paid for round after round, and they became firm friends. Later, on the city walls, Venti asked why he had fled the Church's offer, and suggested a way to make rituals interesting: relay the Anemo Archon's guidance. That night Dahlia became the keeper of Barbatos's secret and his herald. Dahlia passes Venti the nation's news and announces his answers at morning prayers. Venti says a god needs someone to voice his will formally, and no one does it better.

1.comment: Dahlia: The Oracle and the Deaconship
1.content: After his night with Venti, Dahlia returned to the Church claiming to be an oracle bearing Barbatos's words. Many sisters feared a charlatan; others argued that ignoring a true prophecy could do real harm. The second view won, and Sister Victoria proclaimed his words at morning prayers. Rain followed his call to plant, a fierce storm came on the day he warned boats to stay ashore, and hunters doubled their catch on the day he named. The Church offered him the post of deacon. His first morning prayers packed the Cathedral.

2.content: Dahlia's first brush with the Church was doing Rosaria's turn at answering letters while she was away on an investigation. She came back stained with what might have been blood and relayed Victoria's offer of a job; he fled. Now they are very close friends. She was closed-off at first, but he found a way to catch her every time she went missing, and they struck a mutually beneficial agreement. Rosaria likes that he always offers to pay, knows which questions to avoid, and is smart enough that she no longer needs to be guarded with him.

3.content: Barbara is a fellow member of the clergy and a friend. Dahlia calls turning her into an idol a genius marketing move for the Church, whether or not she or Alice intended it. He likes involving her in everything, reasoning that she is happiest helping people. She looks up to him for sharing Barbatos's word, but thinks he never stays at the Cathedral long.

4.content: Kaeya met Dahlia by losing a drinking contest to him and calls his tolerance "through the steeple". They are now top drinking buddies. Kaeya haggles tavern deals for Venti on Dahlia's behalf and collects free drinks for it. Diluc is the one owner Kaeya cannot talk down, so Dahlia never gets a discount at Angel's Share.
